release_notes:
🚀 ALPHA V1.2.14+35: FINAL UI & LOGIC REFINEMENT
• Neutral Impact Fixed: Predicted prices now correctly match live prices for 'Neutral' events—no more empty spaces.
• Exact Dates: Absolute dates (YYYY-MM-DD) now replace relative strings like 'today' or 'tomorrow'.
• Merged AI Reasoning: The Executive Summary is now built into the Reasoning section for a cleaner experience.
• Index & Ticker Hardening: Fixed pricing for NIFTY 50/SENSEX and blocked generic ticker hallucinations.
